summary: Jeff Ipsen, 27, backcountry skier, slid ~1,500 ft in rocks descending the Silver Couloir on Buffalo Mountain, west of Silverthorne, and died of blunt-force trauma; 35 Summit County Rescue responders deployed, CPR unsuccessful; Flight for Life Colorado, Summit County Ambulance, and Lake Dillon Fire Rescue also responded.
location: Silver Couloir, Buffalo Mountain, west of Silverthorne
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; Flight for Life Colorado; Summit County Ambulance Service; Lake Dillon Fire Rescue
notes: date pinned Friday 2012-03-30 (weekday-verified; article published Mon 2012-04-02 reports 'on Friday'); companion story in same article = Knox Frank Ophir Pass avalanche, already indexed as id 2277
